stem:
The stem and leaf plot shows the percentage of questions on a Spanish test that were answered correctly by each student in a class.

Spanish Test

Stem | Leaf
7 | 0 0 0 5 5 5 5 5
8 | 0 0 0 5 5 5
9 | 0 0 5 5
10 | 0

7|0 means 70%.

options.label: A
options.text: Nine students answered 55% of the questions correctly.

options.label: B
options.text: Half the students answered 70% or 75% of the questions correctly.

options.label: C
options.text: Eight students answered more than 80% of the questions correctly.

options.label: D
options.text: Ten students answered 100% of the questions correctly.

visual_elements: Stem and leaf plot showing percentages for Spanish Test with stem values 7, 8, 9, 10 and corresponding leaves for each stem.
